alt: Three Scotland football fans in national-team jerseys smiling in front of a bright yellow 'SCHOOL BUS' — part of a fan-organised fleet of 20 school buses used to transport 1,100 Tartan Army supporters to Gillette Stadium for the 2026 World Cup
story: Scotland fans organised a fleet of 20 yellow school buses to reach Gillette Stadium for the 2026 World Cup after official FIFA shuttles charged $80–95 round-trip — versus the fans' self-organised rate of $38 — because the US public transit system offers no viable route to the venue.
why_funny: Scotland returned to the World Cup for the first time in 28 years only to discover that the host nation's infrastructure is so inadequate that fan volunteers had to charter almost every school bus in Rhode Island to watch the match.
